name: 3D Strategic Defense & Missile Command
description: Ultra-realistic 3D Strategic Defense & Global Warfare simulator. Features procedural weather (clear skies, rain showers, thunderstorm lightning, dynamic wind drift, radar attenuation), Throne Thriller 1 Early Warning Radar, VS-90 Pre-emptive Salvo, Intercept S-5 Mach 15 kinetic defense, 3-tier building collapse, nature-inspired HUD, and Android native APK pipeline.
